runs.title: Why did recalls rise?
runs.question: Why did cardiovascular device recall records rise between 2023 and 2024, and which product codes drove it?
runs.answer: Cardiovascular device recall records rose from 281 in 2023 to 482 in 2024, an increase of 201 records. The three product codes with the largest increases — DSY, DQO, and OEZ — together added 131 records, accounting for 65.2% of the total rise. DSY contributed 53 records from a single event, with the top root cause Equipment maintenance and the top recalling firm Atrium Medical Corporation. DQO contributed 49 records from 3 events involving 3 firms, with the top root cause Under Investigation by firm and the top recalling firm Boston Scientific Corporation. OEZ contributed 29 records from 21 events involving 6 firms, with the top root cause Process control and the top recalling firm MEDLINE INDUSTRIES, LP - Northfield. Additional increases came from DQK, which added 25 records from 4 events involving 4 firms, with the top root cause Under Investigation by firm and the top recalling firm Boston Scientific Corporation, and DPT, which added 22 records from a single event, with the top root cause Process control and the top recalling firm Smiths Medical ASD, Inc.
